review_type: Final independent scientific/source/evidence review; no opaque quality score

criteria.formal_definitions: PASS: C/K/T match exact fact-set, physical cardinality and final acknowledged process outcome; L is separate per-intent observed decision continuity.
criteria.factor_implementation: PASS: D changes only targetless addresses; P retains literal ordered decisions/targets; R adds receipt fast path without changing P retention.
criteria.worker_order: PASS: generation check precedes receipt, receipt/decision hits bypass shared source query, operations commit sequentially, post-loop reset cleanup precedes receipt finalization.
criteria.finite_denominators: PASS: 17 histories x4 profiles minus2 delete exclusions =66/policy and528 total;928 attempts are not additional cases.
criteria.process_barriers: PASS:256 abrupt exits and80 controlled exceptions are accurately distinguished; semantic barriers and post-commit scope are explicit.
criteria.numeric_results: PASS: all main table values,12 conditional factor contrasts and42-operation receipt reduction match independently verified raw cases.
criteria.case_walkthrough: PASS: all three insertion examples match actual records, chosen facts, four committed puts and reported C/K/T/L outcomes.
criteria.boundary_probes: PASS: all five probe rows/counts match stored records and events; pre-store loss and newer-writer loss are correctly interpreted.
criteria.retention: PASS: plans remain under both R settings; metadata removal is explicit deletion, not an unmeasured timer or reclamation guarantee.
criteria.environment_reproduction: PASS: primary and same-host reproduction versions/counts are accurate and datasets are not pooled.
criteria.source_observation_count: PASS:688 belongs only to main campaign; boundary observations are separately checked.
criteria.evidence_pins: PASS: all five displayed source/raw/summary/spec/boundary SHA256 values match the archived artifacts.
criteria.publication_scope: PASS for a candid working manuscript: concrete source-visible mechanism study with public prior art; no invented new algorithm, live-model quality, isolation, production reliability or acceptance claim.
criteria.data_availability: PASS: authorized companion repository URL is disclosed as private, without asserting public access.
criteria.authorship_background: PASS: supplied author is sole listed author; approved employment and prior degree appear in biography, with independent-research role and no current university affiliation asserted.
criteria.release_scope: PASS: approved author biography and companion URL; affiliation/contact text in hash-verified public cited literature is third-party public-source content, not internal material.
criteria.ubuntu_ci_evidence: PASS: two completed successful jobs, matching frozen participant hash, 528 rows and five probes each, all uploaded raw-row scalar metrics independently recomputed and identical to primary. Workflows use Ubuntu; precise runtime versions recorded in ci_evidence_review.json.
criteria.final_layout_only_changes: PASS: figure paths are portable within project, content-gap shortening preserves13/9/29/17, CI supplement is evidence-backed and primary denominator remains528; formulas/mechanisms/probes unchanged.

resolved_minor_wording: Preparation is called a semantic barrier; it is not described as a persisted decision commit under P0.
Only D/R comparisons are said to hold the P retention rule fixed; P itself deliberately varies retention.
scientific_judgment: The manuscript is technically concrete and internally consistent as a finite synthetic mechanism/contract study. It is suitable to circulate as a working preprint or discuss as an experience/artifact contribution. Close prior art and narrow constructed evidence still constrain novelty; this review does not predict external acceptance.
companion_access_status: Private, as explicitly disclosed in the manuscript
allowed_release_exceptions: Human-authorized new companion repository URL in data availability and supporting release/audit metadata
pdf_scope: Compilation and visual PDF QA remain separately root-owned; this pass checks scientific text, figure-data provenance and evidence.
